description: The chart illustrates the proportion of incorrectly answered samples satisfying the condition “RPop_Ge is less than RPop_GT,” shown as percentages for three model series across three domains. The horizontal axis contains the categorical domains “Movies,” “Songs,” and “Basketball,” arranged left to right in that order, and each domain displays a grouped set of three bars. The vertical axis is labeled “Ratio (%)” and uses a linear scale spanning roughly 50% to 90%, with regularly spaced tick marks at 50, 60, 70, 80, and 90. Within each group, the blue bar represents Llama3, the red bar represents Qwen2, and the yellow bar represents ChatGPT (as indicated by the legend at the top). For Movies, the Llama3 bar is just under 90% (about 89%), the Qwen2 bar is at about 90%, and the ChatGPT bar is around 73%. For Songs, Llama3 is around 84%, Qwen2 is about 90%, and ChatGPT is about 62–63%. For Basketball, Llama3 is around 66–67%, Qwen2 is around 57–58%, and ChatGPT is about 61–62%. The bars are presented as side-by-side groups without stacking, and there are no visible annotations, outlines, or other emphasis marks; the category order does not appear to be sorted by bar height.
